title: Founder Runtime Store Live Admission Scope Contract
goal: Define the store live admission scope contract and safety boundary while keeping live CRUD, DB/runtime writes, providers, dispatch, mutation, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not create DB schemas, migrations, DB reads, DB writes, runtime records, live CRUD actions, provider calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or spend.
Do not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw table names, raw report paths, private IDs, or fake runnable actions in primary UX.
reuseCheck: Reuse P130.5 scoped Command Center UX evidence.
Reuse P130.7 final validation handoff evidence.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, mode guards, redaction helpers, route matrices, status helpers, UI components, or evidence/audit/activity appenders.
commandCenterUx: P131.1 does not change dashboard source. The P130.5 scoped Store Live Readiness Gate remains visible only on Business Build and Agent Flow. Chat with NEXUS and Lite stay clean.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, DB writes, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.
